management-and-governance.text: On September 28, 2026, in connection with the closing of the initial public offering (the “IPO”) of shares of Common Stock, the Company filed an amended and restated certificate of incorporation (the “Restated Certificate”) with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware. The Company’s board of directors (the “Board”) and stockholders previously approved the Restated Certificate to be effective immediately prior to the closing of the IPO.
